analyses.groupDescription: Time to respiratory improvement was compared between treatment groups using stratified log-rank test.

primaryOutcomeMeasures.description: Respiratory improvement was defined as sustained peripheral oxygen saturation (SpO2) ≥94% on room air. Median time to respiratory improvement was estimated via the Kaplan-Meier product limit method.

groups.description: Participants received PTC299 at 200 mg, administered orally, BID on Days 1 to 7, then at 50 mg administered orally, QD on Days 8 to 14.
groups.title: PTC299

groups.description: Participants received PTC299-matching placebo administered orally, BID on Days 1 to 7, then administered orally, QD on Days 8 to 14.
groups.title: Placebo

primaryOutcomeMeasures.populationDescription: Intent-to-treat (ITT) population included all randomized participants. Here, 'Overall number of participants analyzed' = participants evaluable for this outcome measure.
primaryOutcomeMeasures.title: Time From Randomization to Respiratory Improvement
